title: allow read-only roles to run git init and ls-files in their own TMPDIR, so a reviewer can check git behaviour with a fixture

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-125602-8f8f, project ork, item S424:

allow read-only roles to run git init and ls-files in their own TMPDIR, so a reviewer can check git behaviour with a fixture

Evidence: mkdir and git init under the reviewer temp dir were denied, which left the nested-repo finding PLAUSIBLE
